name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan
target_group: Eligible unorganised workers aged 18–40 with monthly income below ₹15,000, subject to conditions
eligibility: Not covered by EPFO/ESIC/NPS (government-funded) under current eligibility
benefits: Assured pension of ₹3,000/month after attaining age 60, subject to scheme conditions; Government provides matching contribution.
application_process: Enrol through CSCs or the official PM-SYM enrolment mechanism.
source: Ministry of Labour and Employment / Government of India
